name: [TV3] WF-02: Daily Mood Pulse & Morning Reminder

parameters.query: ={{ $('Weekday Context & Config').first().json.forceUserId ? "SELECT u.id, u.full_name, u.email, u.job_title, d.name AS dept_name FROM users u LEFT JOIN departments d ON u.department_id = d.id WHERE u.id = " + $('Weekday Context & Config').first().json.forceUserId : "SELECT u.id, u.full_name, u.email, u.job_title, d.name AS dept_name FROM users u LEFT JOIN departments d ON u.department_id = d.id WHERE u.role = 'EMPLOYEE' AND u.is_active = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM employee_moods em WHERE em.user_id = u.id AND em.created_at >= CURDATE())" }}

=SELECT u.id, u.full_name, u.job_title, d.name AS dept_name, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(em.created_at)) FROM employee_moods em WHERE em.user_id = u.id AND em.created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 14 DAY)) AS checkin_days, (SELECT DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), MAX(DATE(em2.created_at))) FROM employee_moods em2 WHERE em2.user_id = u.id) AS days_since_last FROM users u LEFT JOIN departments d ON u.department_id = d.id WHERE u.id = {{ $json.id }};
